# ISoundEffects.Reverb property

The sound echoing off the walls of a space, or null for none, the default.

```csharp
public SoundReverb? Reverb { get; set; }
```

## Remarks

Every play with the same reverb shares it. At most eight different reverbs play at once, so a play that would need a ninth plays without reverb.
